tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot Insurance Intake Packet
tickets.text: Prepare an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for the pending Silver Marmot Insurance claim-intake appointment for Harold and Lena Velvetreed.
tickets.evidence: the family needs an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve Aide Shift Minimums in Cost Estimates
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistent aide shift minimums in the projected weekly care cost estimates for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, addressing the discrepancy between an agency quote describing a four-hour minimum and Sofia's call notes showing three-hour visits.
tickets.evidence: One agency quote described a four-hour minimum for daytime shifts, while Sofia’s call notes showed three-hour visits, creating inconsistent assumptions in the projected weekly care cost; the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct Secure Upload Access for Lena
tickets.text: Correct the secure upload access for Lena Velvetreed's claim file, as her portal invitation currently opened under Harold's login, preventing a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s portal invitation opened under Harold’s login, preventing a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to Lena’s claim file; the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Build Family Caregiver Coverage Map
tickets.text: Build a family caregiver coverage map for Harold and Lena Velvetreed incorporating the described changes in mobility limits, Sofia's weekend availability, Martin's remote medication role, Harold's fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Side-by-Side Care Coverage Comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels for Harold and Lena Velvetreed.
tickets.evidence: Harold asked for a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Address Policy Benefit Inflation Assumptions
tickets.text: Address the policy benefit inflation assumptions for Harold and Lena Velvetreed's Silver Marmot Insurance policies, as Mira's review found the two policies use different inflation rider language affecting how daily benefit maximums should be shown.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies use different inflation rider language, which affects how the daily benefit maximums should be shown in the care-cost projections; the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
